note: The bands the Bramor plant has to land in, from docs/BRAMOR-STAGE1.md, which derives each from C-Astral's published figures for the Bramor C4EYE and the drawn planform (scripts/bramor-derive.js). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

b1_cruise.speed0_source: the flight starts at the Bramor user manual's Best Endurance Speed, VBE 16 m/s, the cruise it is measuring; the shared 12 m/s throw is under the manual's 13 m/s stall (VST)
b1_cruise.source: level speed at the throttle the thrust model says holds the published 16 m/s cruise, derived 16.0. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/bramor-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): that throttle is 0.596, was 0.666 on the straight line; the band is the published cruise's and does not move. On the curve the published 5 m/s climb sizes the static thrust at 22.6 N, not the 35 N the table carries (fitted on the straight line); until src/native takes 22.6 the plant is over powered and this gate is red

b2_stall.source: the published 13 m/s at 4.5 kg, which is CL max 0.722 on the drawn 0.591 m2; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.722 / 4.77; the band the flying wing's, minus 6 and plus 13 percent

b3_glide.source: L/D at the 16 m/s cruise, power off, derived 14.2

b4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 28.48; above the published 22 m/s the autopilot flies to and below the 30 m/s never exceed speed (UST 011). Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/bramor-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js) with the static thrust the published climb sizes there, 22.6 N: was 25.0 on the straight line and 22 to 28, 12 percent either way; the same 12 percent is 25.06 to 31.9, held under the never exceed speed. On the curve the published 5 m/s climb sizes the static thrust at 22.6 N, not the 35 N the table carries (fitted on the straight line); until src/native takes 22.6 the plant is over powered and this gate is red

b5_roll.source: full elevon from level at about 20 m/s, as the helix angle pb/2V, derived 0.103 (82 deg/s at 16 m/s); the band the Cub's, minus 29 and plus 35 percent, for a sideslip the derivation leaves out

b6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

b7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds from 1.1 V_s, the published 5 m/s maximum climb that sized the static thrust. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/bramor-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the band is the published climb's and does not move; the derived best is 4.99 at 16.7 m/s on 22.6 N, was 5.01 at 14.3 m/s on 35 N. On the curve the published 5 m/s climb sizes the static thrust at 22.6 N, not the 35 N the table carries (fitted on the straight line); until src/native takes 22.6 the plant is over powered and this gate is red

b8_catapult.source: off the rail at 17 m/s and 20 deg (1.3 V_s, ESTIMATED from the photographs), full throttle: never under 1.1 V_s and never under the release height, and 20 m over it after 10 s, where the derived steady climb alone is 5.0 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 12 x 8 folding curve (prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/bramor-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 4.8 m/s on the straight line

b9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

b10_chute_sink.source: descent under the canopy, the last 5 s before touchdown; the canopy was sized for 5.0 m/s, the middle of a small UAS recovery chute's 4.6 to 6.1 m/s (ESTIMATED: C-Astral publishes no rate)

b11_chute_attitude.source: on its back under the canopy: the body's up axis within 15 deg of straight down, the worst of the last 5 s before touchdown

b12_chute_rest.source: at rest on its back after touchdown: within 15 deg of flat, on the winglets, stopped, the motor stopped, the CG's height within what the hulls' geometry allows for a rest on the winglets across that band (scripts/bramor-gates.js B12), 5 mm the contact's tolerance. Was: the CG at the winglets' 0.25 m plus or minus 0.02, flat, one of the two rests the bounce picks between (a 5.0 m/s touchdown flat, a 5.45 one on the finite wing's broadside force 10 deg nose down)

b13_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and the wing's, the Skyhunter's, the Cub's and the Radian's recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Bramor existed; the Bramor must move none of them. Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, radian each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing). Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

b14_cross_host.source: the Bramor's catapult flight and its chute descent, state trace hashes, Node against headless Chrome
